One- to- one
and, if tempted, your fingertips.
Now with a new two-lane gear lever featuring a dedicated Park What’s more, on petrol-engine versions, overboost is activated.
button, the transmission uses auto-adaptive software to modify This gives access to peak torque at a considerably reduced
its shift patterns according to driving style, for a truly one-to- engine speed. Integrated Vehicle Control (IVC) adds to the
one driving experience. And when it comes to long, high-speed excitement, giving the driver even more dynamic control.
journeys, the last two gears, seventh and eighth, are calibrated
to reduce fuel consumption and further increase comfort. The MANUAL NORMAL MODE
transmission sends power to the rear wheels of all versions This allows the driver to change gear using the optional paddles
via a standard mechanical Limited-Slip Differential (LSD). This behind the steering wheel or the lever on the central tunnel.
ensures superb traction even in challenging situations. For The system automatically shifts up a gear as the red line approaches,
maximum driver involvement, there are five operating modes, and shifts down in the same way.
selected using the buttons near the gear lever:

take place at higher engine speeds. only automatic feature is downshifting if the revs drop too low.
